{{Quotation|game|For centuries the [[Kurzick]]s have gathered in the Eternal Grove to perform the ritual known as the [[Awakening Ceremony|Awakening]]. Outsiders are seldom allowed to witness this ceremony, so very little is known about it, except that this is how Kurzicks create the [[Juggernaut|Forest Defenders]] who defend their lands from their enemies, the [[Luxon]]s.}}

[[The Eternal Grove (outpost)|The Eternal Grove]] is the home of the sacred [[Forever Tree]]s and neighbors [[Vasburg Armory]]. As such, it is highly defended and prized by the Kurzicks.

==Getting there==
You must complete the quest [[The Defenders of the Forest]] in order to gain access if you follow the Kurzick storyline of ''[[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]]''. Alternatively, you can get there from leaving from [[Harvest Temple]] and heading west through [[Morostav Trail]] and then northwest through [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]].
